title: Click-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Nestled in a sunlit grotto of frosted sea-glass and swaying fern-kelp, this pint-sized cephalopod spends its days meticulously clinking colorful pebbles together into intricate, ever-shifting mosaics. Whenever a pleasing new pattern clicks into place on the sandy floor, ripples of bioluminescent constellations flash across its skin in quiet, shimmering celebration.
